echo.title: The Day of Atonement

elements.label: Aaron's two sons died when they drew near before the LORD
Aaron must not come into the holy place at all times, behind the veil
Aaron cast lots over two goats
One goat was the scapegoat sent into the wilderness
The other goat was offered as a sin offering

echo.heart: What does the Day of Atonement teach you about the cost of sin and the grace of God?
echo.mission: Thank God this week for the atonement made through Jesus, and tell someone what it means to you.

echo.title: Elijah is taken up

elements.label: The LORD was about to take Elijah up into heaven
Elisha refused to leave Elijah
A chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared
Elijah went up by a whirlwind
Elijah's mantle fell, and Elisha asked for a double portion

echo.heart: Who has God used in your life to pass on faith to you, and whom are you now mentoring?
echo.mission: Ask an older believer this week how they keep their faith strong, and write down one thing you learn.

echo.title: Give thanks to the LORD

elements.label: Give thanks unto the LORD and call upon his name
Make known his deeds among the people
Sing unto him and talk of all his wondrous works
Glory in his holy name
Seek the LORD and his strength, and seek his face evermore

echo.heart: Which of God's works in your life do you most want to remember and tell others about?
echo.mission: Give thanks aloud this week for three specific things God has done, and share one with a friend.

echo.title: Jehoshaphat's prayer

elements.label: Moab, Ammon and others came to fight against Jehoshaphat
Jehoshaphat feared and set himself to seek the LORD
Judah gathered to ask help from the LORD and fasted
He prayed: we have no might against this great company
The LORD said the battle is not yours but God's

echo.heart: When you face a battle you cannot win alone, what do you do first?
echo.mission: Make a prayer of trust this week, like Jehoshaphat's, about a challenge you face.

echo.title: Ezra prepares his heart

elements.label: Ezra was a ready scribe in the law of Moses
The hand of the LORD his God was upon him
He had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD
He was determined to do it and to teach the statutes
The king granted him all he requested

echo.heart: What does it mean to prepare your heart before you study God's Word?
echo.mission: Before you read the Bible this week, pray for your heart to be ready, and write down what God shows you.

echo.title: Nehemiah's prayer

elements.label: Nehemiah heard that the walls of Jerusalem were broken down
He sat down, wept, and mourned for days
He fasted and prayed before the God of heaven
He confessed the sins of Israel, including his own
He asked God for mercy and success before the king

echo.heart: What burden on your heart could you bring to God in prayer, as Nehemiah did?
echo.mission: Pray for the rebuilding of a broken place in your community this week, and do one practical thing to help.

echo.title: Remember your Creator

elements.label: Remember now your Creator in the days of your youth
The evil days come, when there is no pleasure in them
The dust returns to the earth, and the spirit to God
God will bring every work into judgment
Fear God and keep his commandments; this is the whole duty of man

echo.heart: What would it mean for you to remember God now, not later?
echo.mission: Set one daily habit this week that keeps God first, and review it at the end of the week.

echo.title: The voice of the beloved

elements.label: The beloved comes leaping upon the mountains
He is like a roe or a young hart
The winter is past, and the rain is over and gone
The flowers appear on the earth and the time of singing is come
The voice of the turtle is heard in the land

echo.heart: How does this love song speak to you about the joy of God's love?
echo.mission: Thank God this week for a relationship that brings you joy, and encourage the people in it.

echo.title: Jeremiah is called

elements.label: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah
God knew Jeremiah before he was formed
God ordained him a prophet to the nations
Jeremiah said: I cannot speak, for I am a child
God touched his mouth and put his words in it

echo.heart: Where do you feel too young or unready for God's call, and what does his answer tell you?
echo.mission: Say yes to one small way God has been asking you to serve this month.

echo.title: Great is thy faithfulness

elements.label: Remember the affliction and the gall
The soul is humbled within
The LORD's mercies are new every morning
Great is his faithfulness
The LORD is my portion, therefore I will hope in him

echo.heart: What hope from Lamentations 3 helps you face a hard day?
echo.mission: Each morning this week, read Lamentations 3:22-23 and thank God for his mercies that day.

echo.title: The valley of dry bones

elements.label: Ezekiel was set down in a valley full of bones
The bones were very dry
God asked: can these bones live?
Ezekiel prophesied to the bones, as he was told
Breath came into them and they lived, a great army

echo.heart: Where in your life or community do you need God to breathe new life?
echo.mission: Pray this week for someone or something that feels dry, and ask God to bring life to it.

echo.title: God woos his people

elements.label: God will allure Israel and bring her into the wilderness
The valley of Achor will be a door of hope
God will betroth Israel to himself forever
In righteousness, judgment, mercy and faithfulness
God will say to them: Ye are my people

echo.heart: How does God's faithfulness, even when we fail, change the way you come back to him?
echo.mission: Write a short letter of return to God this week, and read it aloud as a prayer.

echo.title: Return to the LORD

elements.label: Turn to me with all your heart, with fasting and weeping
Rend your heart and not your garments
The LORD is gracious and merciful
He is slow to anger and of great kindness
He repents of the evil

echo.heart: Is there a sin you have been dressing up on the outside that God wants you to deal with inside?
echo.mission: Confess one area of heart-change to God this week, and make one practical change that shows it.

echo.title: Seek good and live

elements.label: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live
So the LORD God of hosts shall be with you
Hate the evil and love the good
Establish judgment in the gate
It may be the LORD will be gracious to the remnant

echo.heart: Where does God call you to choose good over evil in your daily choices?
echo.mission: Stand up for justice in one small way this week, in your home, school or workplace.

echo.title: The day of the LORD

elements.label: The day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen
As you have done, it shall be done to you
Deliverance shall be on mount Zion
The house of Jacob shall be a fire
The kingdom shall be the LORD's

echo.heart: What does Obadiah teach you about pride, and about the justice of God?
echo.mission: Pray this week for anyone who has wronged you, and ask God to deal with the matter as he sees fit.

echo.title: What does the LORD require?

elements.label: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD?
Shall I come with burnt offerings, thousands of rams?
God has shown you what is good: to do justly
To love mercy
To walk humbly with your God

echo.heart: Which of the three, justice, mercy or humility, do you find hardest to practise?
echo.mission: Choose one way to do justly and love mercy this week, and tell a friend about it.

echo.title: The LORD is good

elements.label: The LORD is jealous and revengeth
The LORD is slow to anger and great in power
The clouds are the dust of his feet
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble
He knoweth them that trust in him

echo.heart: Which quality of God in this passage gives you the most security in a time of trouble?
echo.mission: Write down a trouble you face, and pray Nahum 1:7 over it each day this week.

echo.title: Write the vision

elements.label: God told Habakkuk to write the vision and make it plain
Though it tarry, wait for it
The just shall live by his faith
The proud man's soul is not upright in him
The vision will surely come

echo.heart: Where are you waiting on God, and what does it mean to live by faith while you wait?
echo.mission: Write down a vision or promise God has given you, and review it with a friend this week.

echo.title: Sing, O daughter of Zion

elements.label: Sing, O daughter of Zion
The LORD has taken away the judgments against you
The King of Israel is in the midst of you
You shall not see evil any more
He will rest in his love and rejoice over you with singing

echo.heart: What does it mean to you that God rejoices over you with singing?
echo.mission: Sing a song of praise this week, and let it remind you that God delights in you.

echo.title: Consider your ways

elements.label: The people said: the time is not come to build the LORD's house
Consider your ways
You looked for much, and it came to little
Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house
I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified

echo.heart: Where are you putting your own comfort before God's work?
echo.mission: Give time or money this week to a project that builds up God's work, and reflect on it.

echo.title: Not by might, nor by power

elements.label: Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the LORD
Who has despised the day of small things?
The seven eyes of the LORD rejoice to see the plummet
Zerubbabel's hands shall finish the house
You shall know that the LORD has sent me

echo.heart: Where are you tempted to measure God's work by its size, rather than by his Spirit?
echo.mission: Serve in a small way this week, and thank God for the day of small things.

echo.title: Bring all the tithes

elements.label: Will a man rob God? Ye have robbed me in tithes and offerings
Bring all the tithes into the storehouse
Prove me now, says the LORD of hosts
I will open the windows of heaven
I will rebuke the devourer, and all nations shall call you blessed

echo.heart: What does generous giving show about your trust in God?
echo.mission: Decide on one act of generosity this month, and invite God to show you his faithfulness through it.

echo.title: Love is patient

elements.label: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels
Though I have all faith, but have not charity, I am nothing
Charity suffereth long and is kind
It envieth not, vaunteth not itself
Beareth all things, believeth all things, endureth all things

echo.heart: Which quality of love in 1 Corinthians 13 would most change your home or friendships?
echo.mission: Show patient, kind love to someone who is difficult this week, and note what you learn.

echo.title: A new creation

elements.label: If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature
Old things are passed away; all things become new
God has given us the ministry of reconciliation
We are ambassadors for Christ
He made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin

echo.heart: What old habit or fear is God inviting you to let go of, now that you are new in Christ?
echo.mission: Be an ambassador of reconciliation this week: pray for and reach out to someone you are at odds with.

echo.title: Clothe yourselves

elements.label: Put on bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind
Put on meekness and longsuffering
Forbearing one another and forgiving
Above all, put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly

echo.heart: Which quality in Colossians 3 do you most need to put on this week?
echo.mission: Memorise Colossians 3:12 and practise one of its qualities with someone this week.

echo.title: Rejoice, pray, give thanks

elements.label: Rejoice evermore
Pray without ceasing
In every thing give thanks
Quench not the Spirit
Despise not prophesyings; prove all things, hold fast what is good

echo.heart: Which of the three, rejoicing, praying or giving thanks, is hardest for you right now?
echo.mission: Give thanks in everything this week, and keep a note of what you are thankful for.

echo.title: Work quietly and do not grow weary

elements.label: Withdraw from every brother who walks disorderly
If any would not work, neither should he eat
Work with quietness and eat your own bread
Be not weary in well doing
If anyone does not obey, note that man and do not keep company with him

echo.heart: How does honest, steady work reflect your faith to the people around you?
echo.mission: Finish one piece of work this week with care, as an offering to God, and do not grow weary in doing good.

echo.title: An example to believers

elements.label: Let no man despise your youth; be an example in word, conversation and purity
Give attendance to reading, exhortation and doctrine
Neglect not the gift that is in you
Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them
Take heed to yourself and to the doctrine; in doing this you shall save yourself and them

echo.heart: In what way can you be an example to others, whatever your age?
echo.mission: Choose one way this week to set an example in speech, love, faith or purity, and ask a friend to notice.

echo.title: Stir up the gift of God

elements.label: Paul remembers Timothy in his prayers night and day
The unfeigned faith that dwelt first in your grandmother and mother
Stir up the gift of God that is in you
God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power, love and a sound mind
Be not ashamed of the testimony of our Lord

echo.heart: What gift has God given you that you have not yet used fully?
echo.mission: Use one of your gifts this week to encourage someone, and pray for courage to do it boldly.

echo.title: The grace that teaches

elements.label: The grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men
It teaches us to deny ungodliness and worldly lusts
We should live soberly, righteously and godly
We look for the blessed hope and glorious appearing
He gave himself to redeem us from all iniquity

echo.heart: What does God's grace teach you to say no to, and to say yes to?
echo.mission: Name one habit you will say no to this week, and one good work you will say yes to.

echo.title: The love and faith of Philemon

elements.label: Paul thanks God for Philemon, making mention of him in his prayers
Paul hears of Philemon's love and faith towards the Lord Jesus
The bowels of the saints are refreshed by Philemon
Paul has much joy and consolation in his love
Paul asks Philemon to receive a brother back

echo.heart: How can your love and faith refresh the people of God around you?
echo.mission: Refresh someone in your church or family this week with a note, a visit or a prayer.

echo.title: Add to your faith

elements.label: God has given us exceeding great and precious promises
We may be partakers of the divine nature
Add to your faith virtue, knowledge, temperance
Add patience, godliness, brotherly kindness and charity
Make your calling and election sure

echo.heart: Which step in 2 Peter 1 is your next step of growth?
echo.mission: Choose one quality from 2 Peter 1 to grow in this week, and ask a friend to pray with you about it.

echo.title: Walking in the light

elements.label: God is light, and in him is no darkness at all
If we say we have fellowship with him and walk in darkness, we lie
If we walk in the light, we have fellowship one with another
The blood of Jesus cleanseth us from all sin
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive

echo.heart: Is there something hidden that you need to bring into the light and confess?
echo.mission: Confess something to God this week, and find a trusted friend who can pray with you.

echo.title: Walk in truth and love

elements.label: John rejoiced that some walk in truth
He wrote not a new commandment, but one from the beginning
That we love one another
This is love, that we walk after his commandments
This is the commandment, that as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it

echo.heart: How does walking in truth and love connect for you?
echo.mission: Walk in truth and love with one person this week: be honest and kind, both at once.

echo.title: Walk in the truth

elements.label: John prays that Gaius may prosper and be in health
John rejoiced greatly when the brethren came and testified of his truth
John has no greater joy than to hear that his children walk in truth
Gaius has done faithfully whatever he did to the brethren and strangers
We ought therefore to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth

echo.heart: How do you welcome and support fellow believers, especially those you do not know well?
echo.mission: Welcome a visitor or a new believer this week, and help them feel at home.

echo.title: Keep yourselves in the love of God

elements.label: Build yourselves up on your most holy faith
Pray in the Holy Ghost
Keep yourselves in the love of God
Look for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ
He is able to keep you from falling and present you faultless

echo.heart: What helps you keep your footing in faith when the world pulls you off course?
echo.mission: Build yourself up this week: read Jude 20-21 each morning and pray in the Spirit for a friend.
